dct_description_sm:
Lawn Watering Permits are valid for 21 days from the date of application for lawns that have been newly turfed, seeded or treated with nematodes. If required, a re-application can be made for one (1) extension. This extension is valid for an additional 21 days from the original date of expiry - to a maximum of 42 days in total.
